versionImpact.rationale: The alpha adds a governed public release surface for the existing Course Hub image and OCI Compose application without removing the pre-Alpha preview route.

surfaceImpacts.rationale: Buildchain now owns version selection, exact alpha publication, durable evidence, release finalization, and the Release Passport.
The existing linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 Course Hub image becomes an exact versioned release artifact with retained SBOM, provenance, and native-contract smoke evidence.
The one-command OCI Compose application becomes an exact versioned release artifact while the verified compose-preview convenience channel remains compatible.

summary: Runtime Images alpha publishes the Course Hub image and one-command Compose application through one Buildchain-owned, evidence-gated transaction.
